description:
Evolve and maintain corporate website

Create event and re-targeting nurture landing pages

Create various internal micro sites

Constantly analyze and upgrade site by monitoring heat maps and other web performance analytics

Work with external agency and provide monthly reporting by collecting, analyzing, and summarizing data and trends

Participate in relevant conferences and professional organizations 
to constantly learn new responsive and mobile friendly designs and web 
trends

Qualifications:


5-7 years of experience with developing and maintaining a B2B responsive website in Drupal

Expertise in web user interface design and a good eye for design

Well versed with the AWS hosting environment

High proficiency with HTML5, PHP and full LAMP stack

Experience with CSS3 and Sass CSS (Compass)

AWS EC2 and Route53 basic management

Excellent team player with the ability to juggle multiple tasks

A can-do attitude to all tasks

Video creation and editing experience a plus 



 Skill  : PHP, LAMP, Drupal, HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, AWS


 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
